title: [29.x][REPAIR] [ALL-E] Item tracking validation when lot numbers are assigned concerns the warehouse pick level rather than at the sales order level
summary: Changes how Item Tracking Data Collection validates assigned lot numbers, addressing an issue where the validation concerned the warehouse pick level rather than the sales order level. Tests are added in the W1 and RU layers.
